}}{{Short description|Association football club in Moldova}}'''Fotbal Club Petrocub Hîncești''', commonly known as '''Petrocub Hîncești''' ({{respell|PET|roe|kub|_|hin|CHESHT}}), or simply '''Petrocub''', is a Moldovan professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Hîncești]]. They play in the [[Moldovan Liga]], the top tier of [[Football in Moldova|Moldovan football]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.weltfussballarchiv.com/club_profile.php?ID=5259|title=Club Profile, Club History, Club Badge, Results, Fixtures, Historical Logos, Statistics|first=Daniel|last=Groll|website=www.weltfussballarchiv.com|access-date=29 August 2017|archive-date=29 August 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170829202113/http://www.weltfussballarchiv.com/club_profile.php?ID=5259|url-status=dead}}</ref> Its home ground is the [[Stadionul Municipal (Hîncești)|Municipal Stadium]] in [[Hîncești]]."}}
